build_hydra_model: build a HydraModel with a backbone and output heads for predicting atomic properties
create_backbone_interface: create a BackboneInterface subclass that computes embeddings from AtomicData input
create_head_interface: create a HeadInterface subclass that predicts target properties from backbone embeddings
setup_tasks_hydra_model: setup tasks on a HydraModel from a checkpoint config list using setup_tasks
add_inference_tasks: add inference-only tasks like forces or stress to an existing HydraModel
